system.description: The NPC must die where you can see it; you cannot raise a corpse you found. Raise a non-Villain NPC of the beast, monster or plant Species as a minion, for 2 Grave Points and a reduction to your maximum HP and MP equal to its level. Its Species becomes undead and the new dark/light/poison Affinities overwrite any it had; Rank becomes soldier with Skills kept; it arrives at full HP and MP with its original equipment; it takes its own turn on telepathic command and the GM counts it as an additional PC when designing conflicts; it rests when you rest. You lose it at 0 HP, more than one travel day away, if you die or fall unconscious, or if you destroy it — and the reduction ends with it. One at a time. HOUSE RESTRICTION: beast, monster and plant only, never humanoid — a player who wants that version gets a story event with the Miasma Clock and the Medjay both responding, not a heroic they own. The cost rides the Guise that raised the minion; stash the Guise and the minion goes inert with the reduction suspended.
